Enter your details to project your retirement savings.

Projection only — it assumes a constant return and ignores inflation, taxes and fees.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your current age and the age you plan to retire.
  2. Enter your current retirement savings and monthly contribution.
  3. Set your expected average annual return.
  4. Review the projected nest egg, your total contributions and the yearly growth table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the projection calculated?

Future value is projected with compound growth: your current savings grow at the annual return, and each monthly contribution compounds for the time it is invested. Returns are assumed constant, which never happens in reality.

Is the projected value adjusted for inflation?

No. It is before inflation and taxes. A dollar at retirement will buy less than a dollar today, so treat the number as nominal, not real, purchasing power.

What moves the result the most?

Increase your monthly contribution, start earlier, or plan a longer working horizon — the year-by-year table shows how much each extra year of compounding is worth.
